verdict.rationale: Qodo documents a 'PR history' mechanism for learning from team pull request activity (qodo-docs-48), a Relevance score based on how the team handled similar findings before (qodo-docs-53), and a Rule Miner that turns PR history into enforceable rules (qodo-docs-13, qodo-docs-12). Together with the history of findings and decisions (qodo-docs-15) and the ability to dismiss findings (qodo-docs-3), this covers both remembering conventions and applying past review decisions to future PRs. Missing for 10: detail on how dismiss/accept decisions feed back into future reviews and how persistent memory is stored or curated, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the learning works in practice.
